verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a per-model spec page for the flagship grok-4.7 covering modalities, context window, capability flags, reasoning efforts and pricing. The evidence itself calls this 'a specification card, not a safety/system card'. Release notes give only a one-line positioning ('frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work') that loosely implies intended use. Missing for 10: published model/system card, training approach disclosure, evaluation/benchmark results, formal intended-use and limitations section.
